description: Parse messy dates into ISO 8601 — Normalize human or machine date strings into ISO 8601: ISO, RFC 2822, 03/04/2026 (flags day/month ambiguity and gives the alternative), 4 Mar 2026, March 4th 2026 3pm EST, YYYYMMDD, unix seconds/ms, month-year, and relative phrases (today, tomorrow 9:30am, next friday, 3 days ago, in 2 weeks). Times without a zone are read in tz=; returns date, weekday, time, UTC offset, instant, unix, format detected and confidence. Params: date= (one) or dates= (up to 50, separated by |); order= mdy|dmy|ymd for ambiguous numeric dates (default mdy); tz= IANA zone (default UTC); ref= YYYY-MM-DD reference for relative dates (default today). Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_date_parse
